considerations: Vehicle access is available from SW Club House Rd into a large paved parking lot and along a paved road that curves around the building and pool. The site is an administration and recreation building inside a golf and club complex. Circulation space is open in the parking lot. The pool and hardscape sit close to the building and may limit apparatus placement on that side. Open lawn around the greens provides additional movement space. No gates are visible from the imagery. Tennis courts, a pond, and other club buildings occupy the surrounding grounds.
